comment: Windows-only code-signing policy. Signing is a POST-BUILD step over the artifacts that native/installer/build-installer.ps1 produces (staged remcord.exe + dist setup exe). Primary: SignPath free open-source signing (no cert purchase, trusted cert, kills SmartScreen). Fallback: PFX (OV/EV Authenticode cert) + signtool + RFC3161 timestamp. No private key material ever lives in this repo.

artifacts.description: Staged release executable (copied from native/target/release/remcord.exe by build-installer.ps1).
Inno Setup output. {version} expands from the package.json version field (single source, same as build-installer.ps1).

signpath.description: Free for open-source projects via SignPath Foundation (no certificate purchase). CI submits the unsigned artifact, SignPath signs with its trusted cert, CI downloads the signed result.

pfx.description: Paid fallback: OV/EV code-signing certificate as base64 PFX in a secret, or a local file path passed explicitly. URL sources are refused.

releaseRequiresSignatureNote: false matches the CURRENT reality (unsigned builds until free SignPath OSS signing is approved — checklist D/F31). Flip to true only together with: a green SignPath-signed release run whose Confirm-ArtifactSignatures.ps1 output is pasted as evidence. Never flip on a self-signed test certificate (it does not silence SmartScreen).
allowUnsignedNote: Local/dev escape hatch only. When releaseRequiresSignature is true, an unsigned artifact fails the gate unless this variable is explicitly set to '1' AND the run is not CI (GITHUB_ACTIONS unset). CI never honors the escape hatch.
